core_obligations: Existence of the limit object (proof lines 5855-5873): objects correspond to R_n-perfect complexes satisfying condition (2); the existence theorem gives pseudo-coherent E with compatible derived pullbacks.
Perfectness of E (proof lines 5875-5882): the pair is henselian, the kernel lies in the Jacobson radical, and the henselian relatively-perfect lemma makes E R-perfect.
Condition (2) at the limit (proof lines 5884-5890): the vanishing locus is open and holds over V(Ker(R -> R_1)) which contains every point of Spec(R).
proof_roadmap: Translate the effectiveness problem into complexes with condition (2) and produce E by the existence theorem (proof lines 5855-5873).
Upgrade E to R-perfect via the henselian pair (proof lines 5875-5882).
Verify condition (2) globally via the open vanishing locus and the Jacobson radical (proof lines 5884-5890).
